semantic_records.name: PreviousMap
semantic_records.source: Mesen live Overworld/Secret Skills Cave transition
semantic_records.rationale: uint8 origin map: Overworld held 05 after leaving Secret Skills Cave; the cave held 00 after entry from Overworld.

semantic_records.name: EnemyCombatStatStruct
legacy_values: Old enemy anchors were CurrentHP, not struct bases
semantic_records.rationale: Three identical Garbost blocks matched the character combat-stat layout exactly. All three had level 50; CurrentHP changed 637->0/336 while MaxHP stayed 637; the defeated slot's status changed 00->04. Freeze ball changed an undamaged target's status 00->08, confirming Paralyze. A second species exposed the inline name Ramia and different stats at the same offsets. Live IDs 54 Garbost and 3B Ramia matched Abyssonym's complete monster table exactly.

semantic_records.name: BattlePartyCommandSlots
semantic_records.rationale: Mirrored Attack/Defend tests proved 01/04 and 0x0C slot stride.

semantic_records.name: BattlePartyStoredTargetMask
semantic_records.rationale: Party targets stored 01/02/04/08 and all four 0F. Enemy targets set flag 80: live single targets 81/82/84 and all three 87. Enemy bits 08/10/20 and all-six BF are structurally derived, not yet observed in a rare six-enemy encounter.

semantic_records.name: BattleActiveTargetIndex
semantic_records.rationale: Manual left/middle/right selection produced zero-based 00/01/02. This is the fixed temporary cursor only and cannot distinguish R/all-target mode; read the stored command mask after confirmation.

semantic_records.name: BattlePartyActorMask
semantic_records.rationale: The value stayed 04 for Arty while targets changed from 82 to 84; it is an actor mask, not the target or target companion.

semantic_records.name: BattleInitiativeQueue
semantic_records.rationale: Eight materialized entries executed in exact descending order: 266,187,140,133,108,45,45,43. Maximum actor capacity is 11 (four humans, capsule and six enemies).

semantic_records.name: BattleActiveAction
semantic_records.rationale: The active actor sequence matched the initiative queue exactly. Ramia targets 08/10/08 identified Tia/capsule/Tia; Tia HP fell 619->596->571 on the two target-08 actions. The randomized ROM action-name pointer table maps hex ID 16 to Tail attack (15=Miracle voice, 17=Picking).

semantic_records.name: BattleGroupMenuSelection
semantic_records.rationale: Held cursor states matched Fight 09, Trade 0A and Escape 0B.

semantic_records.name: BattleFormation
semantic_records.rationale: Guy/Arty trade changed 02 03 01 04 to 03 02 01 04 without changing canonical party.

semantic_records.name: BattleRewardValidity
semantic_records.rationale: EXP 2689 and gold 4140 matched; old text buffers were unchanged and rewards remain stale after return.

semantic_records.name: BattleIpMenuCursor
semantic_records.rationale: Six manually positioned rows produced index 00-05 and Y values 20,2C,38,44,50,5C.

semantic_records.name: BattleIpEquipmentList
semantic_records.rationale: The battle menu copied all six equipped item IDs here in equipment-slot order.

semantic_records.name: BattleIpRenderedRows
legacy_values: 0x0545B first row; old end 0x056CE omitted row six
semantic_records.rationale: Six screenshots matched six interleaved-ASCII rows. WRAM stores item IDs and rendered names, not a separate six-entry IP-ID list.

semantic_records.name: BattleIpAvailability
semantic_records.rationale: Attribute 20 marked costs <= Guy's 96 IP usable; 24 marked costs above 96 unusable. Equality at 96 was usable.

semantic_records.name: BattleIpConsumption
semantic_records.rationale: Sleep Stinger cost 96: selection and target confirmation kept 96; actual execution changed 96 to 0.

semantic_records.name: BattleMagicMenuCursor
semantic_records.rationale: True top, horizontal, vertical, first empty and true 36-slot end states matched.

semantic_records.name: BattleMagicRenderedRows
semantic_records.rationale: Two-column scrolling pane exposes randomized live costs and attribute 20 usable / 24 disabled.

semantic_records.name: CharacterSpellSlots
semantic_records.rationale: Battle and field menu share the same fixed 36-slot order; FF slots are empty but navigable.

semantic_records.name: BattleMagicSelectionAndConsumption
semantic_records.rationale: Fireball produced command 02, spell ID 04; MP stayed 471 through selection then fell to 465 on execution, matching live cost 6.

semantic_records.name: BattleItemMenuCursor
semantic_records.rationale: Empty slot 1, occupied slots 2/3 and true slot 96 end matched fixed raw inventory positions.

semantic_records.name: BattleItemRenderedRows
semantic_records.rationale: Rows preserve empty inventory slots; attribute 20 means battle-usable and 24 means visible but disabled.

semantic_records.name: InventorySlotStructure
semantic_records.rationale: 96 fixed two-byte slots require 0xC0 bytes; old helper length 0xBF omitted slot 96's second byte.

semantic_records.name: BattleItemSelectionAndConsumption
semantic_records.rationale: Charred Newt command 03 stored 01 02. Selection transition temporarily cleared the slot; final empty slot plus Guy MP 465 to 470 proved execution.

semantic_records.name: DungeonActorLayout
semantic_records.source: Mesen controlled movement audit plus ROM dispatch inspection
semantic_records.rationale: Forty slots 00-27; FF is empty. Controlled up/down/left/right changed only the matching tile axis. Movement-state bit 0 distinguishes moving from idle. Stable direction uses 00 south, 02 west, 04 north, 06 east; facing uses low bits 0-3.

semantic_records.name: DungeonActorMovementMode
semantic_records.source: Authoritative Terrorwave MonsterMoveObject plus live Mesen
semantic_records.rationale: For overworld sprites 80-EF, the runtime byte equals ROM MonsterMoveObject[SpriteID-80]. All six loaded monster actors matched the randomized ROM table.

semantic_records.name: DungeonBlockedAttempt
semantic_records.rationale: A visible south-wall attempt produced FF->01 at 7E:1272 with unchanged X/Y. ROM code stores attempted direction on collision and resets FF on success: 00 north, 01 south, 02 west, 03 east. The old 7E:3586 mapping is unsupported.

semantic_records.name: SelectedDungeonToolCode
semantic_records.rationale: Bomb selection matched A8 01 and ASCII name Bomb at 7E:0B77.

semantic_records.name: DungeonToolActionState
semantic_records.rationale: Bomb lifecycle matched 00 idle, 77 placed, 7F explosion, 00 idle.

semantic_records.name: NpcDialogIndicator
semantic_records.rationale: Two NPCs matched 0000 -> 8801 -> 0000; an open shop remained 0000.

semantic_records.name: SaveSelectionCursor
semantic_records.rationale: All seven visible cursor positions atomically matched value and companion byte.

semantic_records.name: NameEntryCursor
semantic_records.rationale: Live candidate; not every name-grid position has been exercised.

raw_claims.context: All offsets are relative to WRAM Base (7E0000). To read using x64 Snes9x, add these to the dynamically found WRAM Base address.
ROM table bases and emulator-specific pointers. ROM offsets are linear (unheadered).
Character stat blocks start at 0x2EBE (Maxim). Each block is 0xBE (190) bytes long.
DEATH INDICATORS: Character is deceased if (CurrentHP == 0) OR (Status bit 2 [0x04] is set).
Enemy stats are stored in 6 slots starting at 0x3940. Each enemy struct is 0xBE (190) bytes long.

No separate six-entry IP-ID list was observed. Parse the randomized ROM assignment for numeric IDs, or use rendered names plus ip_skills.json without OCR.
